evals.prompt: This is a proof of concept with no customers. package.json has no test library, and I do not see test files.
evals.expected_output: Says testing is not set up. Names the missing library and the missing files. Does not recommend end-to-end tests. Does not invent a coverage percent.
assertions: Says testing is not set up
Names the missing library and the missing files
Does not invent a coverage percent

evals.prompt: package.json lists vitest. There are no test files in the repo.
evals.expected_output: Names vitest as the test library. Says the suite is declared, not written. Does not call it a test suite.
assertions: Names vitest as the test library
Says the suite is declared, not written
Does not call it a test suite

evals.prompt: We have paying customers. There are unit tests for helpers. Nothing tests the checkout path, and there is no end-to-end test.
evals.expected_output: Says unit tests exist and names that they are not on checkout. Says the gap is the path that takes payment, with impact on revenue and support. Does not invent a coverage percent.
assertions: Says they are not on the checkout path
Says the impact is on revenue and support
Does not invent a coverage percent

evals.prompt: We have revenue. Unit tests and an end-to-end test cover signup. I do not see a coverage script or config, and there is no coverage report.
evals.expected_output: Says unit and end-to-end tests are present. Says coverage is the next step. Says the percent is unseen. Does not invent a target.
assertions: Says unit and end-to-end tests are present
Says coverage is the next step

evals.prompt: Are production errors caught in Sentry?
evals.expected_output: Uses the sentry skill. Does not score the test suite.
assertions: Does not score the test suite
